outside.text: the plane does not meet the solid (registry 1.6)

touch.text: the plane meets the solid only at a vertex or along an edge (registry 1.6)

flat.text: the solid has no volume: its vertices lie in one plane (registry 1.6)

not_convex.text: the base or the solid is not convex (registry 1.6)

not_planar.text: the vertices of a polygon or a base do not lie in one plane (registry 1.6)

skew.text: the lines are skew: they have no common point and are not parallel (registry 1.6)

coplanar.text: the line lies in the plane (registry 1.6)

space_unsupported.text: an operation of the plane in a space document, or of space in a plane one (registry 1.6)
